name: marblingclear
source:
Wata, a vampire, washes up on an island where a god is worshipped as "Mother". After drinking the "demon-sealing cursed blood" of "Mother's" trustee Momen, Wata is cursed to die if he drinks any blood other than Momen's. Wata begins his life on the island.....

[translated from [url=https://nemurita.booth.pm/items/4158065]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼瓦塔（Wata）被冲到一座被崇拜为“母亲”的神灵的岛屿上。瓦塔喝下了“母亲”的受托人魔门的“封魔诅咒之血”后，如果喝了魔门以外的任何血液，就会被诅咒而死。渡在岛上开始了他的生活……

[译自[url=https://nemurita.booth.pm/items/4158065]BOOTH[/url]]
